name: Magic Cube -> HomeKit (12 outputs)
info:
Outputs 1-10: one StatelessProgrammableSwitch event per gesture -> { ProgrammableSwitchEvent: 0 }. wakeup leads (the cube's initial/resting gesture); the remaining 8 (fall, flip180, flip90, rotate_left, rotate_right, shake, slide, tap, throw) are plain alphabetical order.
Output 11: side -> { side: 0-5 }, whenever the resting side changes.
Output 12: battery -> { BatteryLevel, ChargingState, StatusLowBattery } shaped for NRCHKB's Battery linked service, whenever battery % changes.

See magic-cube-homekit-parser.js for full documentation, and magic-cube-gesture-reference.md for the underlying gesture data this is built from.
